# agentgateway_llm_providers (Data Source)

Reusable LLM provider entries, sorted by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every reusable provider entry, sorted by id.
data "agentgateway_llm_providers" "all" {}

# Only the entries whose id starts with a prefix.
data "agentgateway_llm_providers" "team" {
  name_prefix = "team-"
}

output "provider_names" {
  value = [for provider in data.agentgateway_llm_providers.all.providers : provider.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only include providers whose id (the name) starts with this prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the listing: `llm.provider:<name_prefix>`.
- `providers` (Attributes List) Provider entries stored by the gateway, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `base_url` (String) Upstream base URL.
- `model` (String) Upstream model id.
- `name` (String) Provider entry name.
- `provider` (String) Provider name, or the custom provider object as JSON.
